notes.title: Added an achievement! New game engine!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31784221/3265459b03defb69a03f0c28702f8f4d61d7aa7d.jpg[/img]

1. An achievement has finally been added to the game. Now this game will easily show you "+1 perfect game"! Achievement opens immediately when opening the game!
2. The game was ported to a new version of the licensed game engine.
3. In the game there has been a slight improvement in gameplay and optimization. the game engine!
